{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
total_revenue = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
